field.name: minimum_working_age
field.label: Minimum working age
field.help: The youngest age a person may be hired, on the day they join. Checked on the enrollment form and when hiring.

field.name: manager_rank_rule
field.label: Managers must rank
field.help: strict: strictly above the people reporting to them. equal_ok: above or equal. Ranks come from grades; people and positions without a grade are not checked.

field.name: pay_mode
field.label: How base wage is decided
field.help: individual: entered for each person. position: everyone in a position gets its base wage. hybrid: the position's wage, unless a person has their own.
